| cfg_url = http://www.apocalypse2000.org.uk }} {|align=left |__TOC__ |} [[Image:a2klogo2.png]] == History == ===Early years=== a2k were founded on the 11th of May 1999 by red and shadz. red at the time was unclanned after quitting [[Dark Vengeance]] a few months before, shadz was in TGC, both of them wanted to give clan leadership a try. Our first member was h3xy, who was also in TGC with shadz. Next up was clarkus, who knew shadz from a FFA server. He was currently in EOA after leaving COC, a clan setup with some of his friends. He claimed to keep forgetting to tell EOA he was leaving them; but personally I think he was just keeping his options open :D. qmole joined next. He was in TGC along with shadz and h3xy, but had quit recently to join GM. He joined us a couple of weeks after we formed. red, shadz, h3xy, clarkus and qmole. That is our original line-up. A few other players joined during our first few months of activity, but most didnt stay for very long. During the year 2000 we had a few more players join that actually stayed for a while. Duce (currently of hhh) became our first euro. Shortly after he joined he said he knew of somebody that might want to join, that was Ayvern (aka banana-joe of hyphen) who did indeed join. Gibbs (also of hyphen) joined shortly after. On the 16th of February 2001 we merged with Fatal Error. Which saw browngasm, def, kamikazi & some other people that I can't remember added to our squad. This also saw cosmos have his first stay, who joined as a joint leader. Not sure how long this lasted for tho, but I think majority of the FE players left after a few months or weeks due to lack of games. For a change we actually had too many players. And thats all I can remember of the past. ===The new era=== ---- ====NQR 6==== Players: [[Image:flag_england.gif]] [[clarkus]], [[Image:flag_scotland.gif]] [[cosmos]], [[Image:flag_england.gif]] [[qmole]], [[Image:flag_se.gif]] [[Willgurht]], [[Image:flag_se.gif]] [[tGM]], [[Image:flag_england.gif]] [[red]] ,[[Image:flag_england.gif]] [[doser]], [[Image:flag_england.gif]] [[des]] a2k was reformed by qmole for NQR6. The lineup at the start of the season included red, clarkus, qmole, doser, cosmos and Willgurht. tGM, being new to quakeworld 4on4 joined during the first weeks and quickly made it into the first lineup.
